description: 11 mechanic kits the autopilot can drop into a scene slot. lua_template is a full per-scene module; the autopilot substitutes {SCENE_ID}, {SCENE_NAME}, {SCENE_TITLE} tokens then writes to scenes/{SCENE_ID}.lua.

recipes.name: Crank lockpick
recipes.premise: Pin-tumbler lockpick scene. Crank rotates a tension wrench; A drives the current pin. Each pin has a hidden sweet-spot angle window. Overshoot resets the pin. Series of pins to clear in order.

controls.a: set current pin when in sweet spot

recipes.visual_brief: Side cutaway of a 5-pin tumbler in 1-bit. Atkinson-dithered brass body, pure-black pins, sweet-spot indicator as a faint Bayer 8x8 wedge. Tension wrench rotates as a hairline. Bottom strip: [CRANK] tension  [A] set pin  [B] abandon.
recipes.lua_template:
-- scenes/{SCENE_ID}.lua
-- {SCENE_NAME} — crank_lockpick recipe.
import "CoreLibs/crank"
import "CoreLibs/timer"

local gfx <const> = playdate.graphics
local Scene = {}
local state = {}

function Scene.enter()
    state.pins    = { {angle=80,window=12,set=false}, {angle=150,window=10,set=false}, {angle=220,window=8,set=false} }
    state.current = 1
    state.tension = 0
    state.failure_flash = 0
    state.cleared = false
    state.sfx_click = playdate.sound.sampleplayer.new("sfx/{SCENE_ID}_click")
    state.sfx_set   = playdate.sound.sampleplayer.new("sfx/{SCENE_ID}_set")
    state.sfx_fail  = playdate.sound.sampleplayer.new("sfx/{SCENE_ID}_fail")
end

function Scene.exit()
    if state.sfx_click then state.sfx_click:stop() end
end

function playdate.cranked(change, _accel)
    state.tension = (state.tension + change) % 360
    if math.abs(change) > 4 and state.sfx_click then state.sfx_click:play(1) end
end

function Scene.update(_dt)
    if state.cleared then return end
    playdate.timer.updateTimers()
    if playdate.buttonJustPressed(playdate.kButtonA) then
        local pin = state.pins[state.current]
        local delta = math.abs(state.tension - pin.angle)
        if delta <= pin.window then
            pin.set = true
            state.current = state.current + 1
            if state.sfx_set then state.sfx_set:play(1) end
            if state.current > #state.pins then state.cleared = true end
        else
            for _, p in ipairs(state.pins) do p.set = false end
            state.current = 1
            state.failure_flash = 18
            if state.sfx_fail then state.sfx_fail:play(1) end
        end
    end
    if state.failure_flash > 0 then state.failure_flash = state.failure_flash - 1 end
end

function Scene.draw()
    gfx.clear(gfx.kColorWhite)
    gfx.drawText("{SCENE_NAME}", 12, 12)
    gfx.drawText(string.format("tension %d deg", math.floor(state.tension)), 12, 32)
    gfx.drawText(string.format("pin %d/%d", state.current, #state.pins), 12, 52)
    if state.cleared then
        gfx.drawText("** LOCK OPEN **", 140, 110)
    elseif state.failure_flash > 0 then
        gfx.fillRect(0, 0, 400, 240)
    end
    gfx.drawText("[CRANK] tension  [A] set pin  [B] abandon", 8, 220)
end

function Scene.input(evt)
    if evt == "b" then scene_manager.pop() end
end

return Scene

recipes.name: Tilt maze
recipes.premise: A ball-bearing rolls through a 1-bit maze under accelerometer gravity. Tilt the device to steer; reach the exit before time runs out. Holes restart the level.
recipes.visual_brief: Top-down 1-bit maze. Walls thick black with Atkinson highlights, floor pure white, holes solid black voids. Ball-bearing pure white with 1-pixel black outline, drop shadow as a 2x2 stipple offset 2 pixels. HUD: timer ring upper-right.
recipes.lua_template:
-- scenes/{SCENE_ID}.lua
-- {SCENE_NAME} — tilt_maze recipe.
import "CoreLibs/timer"

local gfx <const> = playdate.graphics
local Scene = {}
local state = {}

function Scene.enter()
    state.ball = { x=24, y=24, vx=0, vy=0 }
    state.walls = {
        {x=0,y=0,w=400,h=4}, {x=0,y=236,w=400,h=4},
        {x=0,y=0,w=4,h=240}, {x=396,y=0,w=4,h=240},
        {x=80,y=40,w=4,h=160}, {x=160,y=80,w=4,h=160},
        {x=240,y=40,w=4,h=160}, {x=320,y=80,w=4,h=160}
    }
    state.holes = { {x=120,y=120,r=10}, {x=280,y=140,r=10} }
    state.exit  = {x=372, y=212, r=12}
    state.zero_x, state.zero_y = 0, 0
    state.elapsed_ms = 0
    state.cleared = false
    playdate.startAccelerometer()
end

function Scene.exit()
    playdate.stopAccelerometer()
end

local function rect_contains(r, x, y)
    return x >= r.x and x <= r.x + r.w and y >= r.y and y <= r.y + r.h
end

function Scene.update(dt)
    if state.cleared then return end
    state.elapsed_ms = state.elapsed_ms + (dt or 1/30) * 1000
    local ax, ay = playdate.readAccelerometer()
    ax = (ax or 0) - state.zero_x
    ay = (ay or 0) - state.zero_y
    state.ball.vx = state.ball.vx * 0.92 + ax * 1.4
    state.ball.vy = state.ball.vy * 0.92 + ay * 1.4
    local nx = state.ball.x + state.ball.vx
    local ny = state.ball.y + state.ball.vy
    for _, w in ipairs(state.walls) do
        if rect_contains(w, nx, state.ball.y) then state.ball.vx = -state.ball.vx*0.4; nx = state.ball.x end
        if rect_contains(w, state.ball.x, ny) then state.ball.vy = -state.ball.vy*0.4; ny = state.ball.y end
    end
    state.ball.x, state.ball.y = nx, ny
    for _, h in ipairs(state.holes) do
        local dx, dy = state.ball.x - h.x, state.ball.y - h.y
        if dx*dx + dy*dy < h.r*h.r then Scene.enter(); return end
    end
    local dx, dy = state.ball.x - state.exit.x, state.ball.y - state.exit.y
    if dx*dx + dy*dy < state.exit.r * state.exit.r then state.cleared = true end
    if playdate.buttonJustPressed(playdate.kButtonB) then Scene.enter() end
    if playdate.buttonJustPressed(playdate.kButtonA) then
        state.zero_x, state.zero_y = playdate.readAccelerometer()
    end
end

function Scene.draw()
    gfx.clear(gfx.kColorWhite)
    gfx.setColor(gfx.kColorBlack)
    for _, w in ipairs(state.walls) do gfx.fillRect(w.x, w.y, w.w, w.h) end
    for _, h in ipairs(state.holes) do gfx.fillCircleAtPoint(h.x, h.y, h.r) end
    gfx.drawCircleAtPoint(state.exit.x, state.exit.y, state.exit.r)
    gfx.fillCircleAtPoint(state.ball.x, state.ball.y, 5)
    if state.cleared then gfx.drawText("** ESCAPED **", 140, 110) end
    gfx.drawText("[TILT] steer  [A] zero  [B] restart", 8, 220)
end

function Scene.input(_) end
return Scene

recipes.name: Rhythm crank
recipes.premise: Notes scroll right-to-left along a track at a fixed BPM. The crank must rotate at a target rate when a note hits the strike-zone. Speed match within tolerance = HIT, else MISS. Combo multiplier for sustained matches.
recipes.state_template:
state.bpm = 100
state.notes = {} -- {t_ms, target_rate}
state.start_ms = 0
state.combo = 0
state.score = 0
recipes.visual_brief: Horizontal track with the strike-zone at x=80. Notes drift left as black filled squares 24x24. Target rate indicator: thick arrow above strike-zone. Player's current rate: thin arrow. Combo counter top-right in Roobert 24. Background: pure white, no dither (keep motion-clean per Panic flashing rules).
recipes.lua_template:
-- scenes/{SCENE_ID}.lua
-- {SCENE_NAME} — rhythm_crank recipe.
import "CoreLibs/crank"
import "CoreLibs/timer"
import "CoreLibs/ui"

local gfx <const> = playdate.graphics
local Scene = {}
local state = {}
local STRIKE_X = 80
local NOTE_PX_PER_MS = 0.12

function Scene.enter()
    state.bpm = 100
    state.notes = {}
    local interval = 60000 / state.bpm / 2
    for i = 1, 32 do
        table.insert(state.notes, { t_ms = i * interval, target_rate = 180 + (i % 3) * 60 })
    end
    state.start_ms = playdate.getCurrentTimeMilliseconds()
    state.combo  = 0
    state.score  = 0
    state.rate   = 0
    state.running = true
    state.music = playdate.sound.fileplayer.new("music/{SCENE_ID}_loop")
    if state.music then state.music:play(0) end
    state.sfx_hit  = playdate.sound.sampleplayer.new("sfx/{SCENE_ID}_hit")
    state.sfx_miss = playdate.sound.sampleplayer.new("sfx/{SCENE_ID}_miss")
    playdate.ui.crankIndicator:start()
end

function Scene.exit()
    if state.music then state.music:stop() end
end

function Scene.update(_dt)
    playdate.timer.updateTimers()
    if not state.running then return end
    local change = playdate.getCrankChange()
    state.rate = math.abs(change) * 30
    local now = playdate.getCurrentTimeMilliseconds() - state.start_ms
    for i = #state.notes, 1, -1 do
        local n = state.notes[i]
        if math.abs(n.t_ms - now) < 80 then
            local err = math.abs(state.rate - n.target_rate)
            if err < 50 then
                state.combo = state.combo + 1
                state.score = state.score + 100 * state.combo
                if state.sfx_hit then state.sfx_hit:play(1) end
            else
                state.combo = 0
                if state.sfx_miss then state.sfx_miss:play(1) end
            end
            table.remove(state.notes, i)
        elseif n.t_ms + 80 < now then
            state.combo = 0
            table.remove(state.notes, i)
        end
    end
    if playdate.buttonJustPressed(playdate.kButtonA) then state.running = not state.running end
end

function Scene.draw()
    gfx.clear(gfx.kColorWhite)
    gfx.drawLine(0, 120, 400, 120)
    gfx.drawLine(STRIKE_X, 80, STRIKE_X, 160)
    local now = playdate.getCurrentTimeMilliseconds() - state.start_ms
    for _, n in ipairs(state.notes) do
        local x = STRIKE_X + (n.t_ms - now) * NOTE_PX_PER_MS
        if x > -30 and x < 410 then gfx.fillRect(x-12, 108, 24, 24) end
    end
    gfx.drawText(string.format("combo %d  score %d", state.combo, state.score), 8, 8)
    gfx.drawText(string.format("rate %d", math.floor(state.rate)), 8, 200)
    if playdate.isCrankDocked() then playdate.ui.crankIndicator:update() end
    gfx.drawText("[CRANK] match rate  [A] pause  [B] abort", 8, 220)
end

function Scene.input(evt)
    if evt == "b" then scene_manager.pop() end
end
return Scene

recipes.name: Dialog wheel
recipes.premise: Talk to an NPC. Crank rotates a radial wheel of dialog options; A commits the highlighted choice. Each choice fires a callback (reputation delta, set flag, advance to next page). Portrait + speaker label persist.
recipes.visual_brief: Left third of screen: 1-bit Atkinson-dithered portrait 120x180. Right two thirds: dialog text wraps in a rect, four choices arranged on a 3/4 wheel below. Selected choice swells; others rendered at smaller cap height. Speaker label uppercase Roobert 20 Medium with 2px underline.
recipes.lua_template:
-- scenes/{SCENE_ID}.lua
-- {SCENE_NAME} — dialog_wheel recipe.
import "CoreLibs/crank"
import "CoreLibs/ui"

local gfx <const> = playdate.graphics
local Scene = {}
local state = {}

function Scene.enter()
    state.pages = {
        { speaker="COURIER", line="You shouldn't be here.",
          choices = {
            { label="I have business with the boss.", id="push"      },
            { label="Sorry, wrong door.",             id="retreat"   },
            { label="Then nobody is.",                id="threat"    },
            { label="...",                            id="silent"    }
          }
        }
    }
    state.page    = 1
    state.choice  = 1
    state.portrait = playdate.graphics.image.new("images/{SCENE_ID}_portrait")
    state.sfx_tick = playdate.sound.sampleplayer.new("sfx/{SCENE_ID}_tick")
    state.sfx_pick = playdate.sound.sampleplayer.new("sfx/{SCENE_ID}_pick")
end

function Scene.exit() end

function Scene.update(_dt)
    local page = state.pages[state.page]
    if page == nil then scene_manager.pop(); return end
    local ticks = playdate.getCrankTicks(#page.choices)
    if ticks ~= 0 then
        state.choice = ((state.choice - 1 + ticks) % #page.choices + #page.choices) % #page.choices + 1
        if state.sfx_tick then state.sfx_tick:play(1) end
    end
    if playdate.buttonJustPressed(playdate.kButtonA) then
        local picked = page.choices[state.choice]
        if state.sfx_pick then state.sfx_pick:play(1) end
        save_state.set("{SCENE_ID}_last_choice", picked.id)
        state.page = state.page + 1
        state.choice = 1
    end
    if playdate.buttonJustPressed(playdate.kButtonB) then scene_manager.pop() end
end

function Scene.draw()
    gfx.clear(gfx.kColorWhite)
    if state.portrait then state.portrait:draw(8, 30) end
    local page = state.pages[state.page]
    if page == nil then return end
    gfx.drawText(page.speaker, 140, 16)
    gfx.drawLine(140, 34, 392, 34)
    gfx.drawTextInRect(page.line, 140, 44, 252, 60)
    for i, c in ipairs(page.choices) do
        local prefix = (i == state.choice) and "> " or "  "
        gfx.drawText(prefix .. c.label, 140, 110 + (i-1) * 22)
    end
    gfx.drawText("[CRANK] choose  [A] commit  [B] back", 8, 220)
end

function Scene.input(_) end
return Scene

recipes.name: Crank character creator
recipes.premise: Eight-category appearance + identity wizard. Crank browses options inside the active category, d-pad jumps between categories, A advances, B retreats. Final category is name (onscreen keyboard). Selection is persisted to datastore on confirm so subsequent scenes can read the player's avatar.
recipes.visual_brief: Center panel: 120x180 character preview composited from the imagetable frames of every locked category. Right rail: vertical list of 8 category names with current one highlighted by a black bar. Bottom strip: [CRANK] browse  [D-PAD] category  [A] next  [B] back. Name entry uses the system keyboard.
recipes.lua_template:
-- scenes/{SCENE_ID}.lua
-- {SCENE_NAME} — character_creator_crank recipe.
import "CoreLibs/crank"
import "CoreLibs/keyboard"
import "runtime/concepts/character_creator"

local gfx <const> = playdate.graphics
local Scene = {}
local state = {}

function Scene.enter()
    state.cc = character_creator.new({
        storage_key = "{SCENE_ID}_avatar",
        categories = {
            { id="head_shape", label="HEAD",       imagetable_path="images/{SCENE_ID}_head"       },
            { id="eyes",       label="EYES",       imagetable_path="images/{SCENE_ID}_eyes"       },
            { id="mouth",      label="MOUTH",      imagetable_path="images/{SCENE_ID}_mouth"      },
            { id="hat_or_hood",label="HEADWEAR",   imagetable_path="images/{SCENE_ID}_hat"        },
            { id="body",       label="BODY",       imagetable_path="images/{SCENE_ID}_body"       },
            { id="accessory",  label="ACCESSORY",  imagetable_path="images/{SCENE_ID}_accessory" },
            { id="name",       label="NAME",       kind="keyboard",   max_length=12              }
        },
        on_confirm = function(avatar) save_state.set("{SCENE_ID}_avatar", avatar); scene_manager.pop() end,
        on_cancel  = function() scene_manager.pop() end
    })
end

function Scene.exit() state.cc:teardown() end

function Scene.update(dt) state.cc:update(dt) end
function Scene.draw()   state.cc:draw()   end
function Scene.input(evt) state.cc:input(evt) end

function playdate.cranked(change, _accel) if state.cc then state.cc:on_crank(change) end end

return Scene

recipes.name: Conveyor sort
recipes.premise: Items drift right on a conveyor at variable speed. The player crank-spins to set speed; A and B sort items into one of two bins. Wrong sorts deplete a strike counter; three strikes ends the shift.
recipes.state_template:
state.items = {} -- {id, kind, x}
state.speed = 60
state.strikes = 0
state.score = 0
recipes.visual_brief: Side view of a conveyor mid-screen with diagonal tread lines moving right. Items are 32x32 silhouette icons (two distinct types, e.g. round vs square). Top + bottom bins are 80x60 black boxes labeled in Roobert 20. Strike indicator: three X marks lower-left, fill as strikes accrue.
recipes.lua_template:
-- scenes/{SCENE_ID}.lua
-- {SCENE_NAME} — conveyor_sort recipe.
import "CoreLibs/crank"
import "CoreLibs/timer"

local gfx <const> = playdate.graphics
local Scene = {}
local state = {}

function Scene.enter()
    state.items   = {}
    state.speed   = 60
    state.strikes = 0
    state.score   = 0
    state.spawn_ms = 0
    state.sfx_good = playdate.sound.sampleplayer.new("sfx/{SCENE_ID}_good")
    state.sfx_bad  = playdate.sound.sampleplayer.new("sfx/{SCENE_ID}_bad")
end

function Scene.exit() end

local function spawn_item()
    local kinds = { "round", "square" }
    table.insert(state.items, { kind = kinds[math.random(1,2)], x = -32 })
end

function Scene.update(dt)
    playdate.timer.updateTimers()
    state.spawn_ms = state.spawn_ms + (dt or 1/30) * 1000
    if state.spawn_ms >= 1500 then state.spawn_ms = 0; spawn_item() end
    local change = playdate.getCrankChange()
    state.speed = math.max(20, math.min(220, state.speed + change * 0.5))
    for i = #state.items, 1, -1 do
        state.items[i].x = state.items[i].x + state.speed * (dt or 1/30)
        if state.items[i].x > 420 then table.remove(state.items, i) end
    end
    local front = state.items[1]
    if front and front.x > 200 then
        local pressed_a = playdate.buttonJustPressed(playdate.kButtonA)
        local pressed_b = playdate.buttonJustPressed(playdate.kButtonB)
        if pressed_a or pressed_b then
            local want = pressed_a and "round" or "square"
            if front.kind == want then
                state.score = state.score + 100
                if state.sfx_good then state.sfx_good:play(1) end
            else
                state.strikes = state.strikes + 1
                if state.sfx_bad then state.sfx_bad:play(1) end
            end
            table.remove(state.items, 1)
        end
    end
    if state.strikes >= 3 then scene_manager.pop() end
end

function Scene.draw()
    gfx.clear(gfx.kColorWhite)
    gfx.fillRect(0, 130, 400, 4)
    for _, it in ipairs(state.items) do
        if it.kind == "round" then gfx.fillCircleAtPoint(it.x, 114, 14)
        else gfx.fillRect(it.x-14, 100, 28, 28) end
    end
    gfx.drawRect(8, 24, 80, 60); gfx.drawText("ROUND [A]", 12, 44)
    gfx.drawRect(8, 156, 80, 60); gfx.drawText("SQUARE [B]", 12, 176)
    gfx.drawText(string.format("score %d  strikes %d/3", state.score, state.strikes), 200, 220)
end

function Scene.input(_) end
return Scene

recipes.name: Wave defense
recipes.premise: Stationary turret at screen-center, enemies spawn off-screen and walk toward the turret. Crank rotates turret aim, A fires. Each wave is bigger and faster. Survive N waves to clear.
recipes.visual_brief: Top-down. Turret in center as 32x32 silhouette with a 24px barrel oriented to aim. Enemies are 24x24 silhouettes with subtle gait animation. Bullets 4x4 squares. Wave counter top-center in Roobert 24. HP as 5 pips lower-left.
recipes.lua_template:
-- scenes/{SCENE_ID}.lua
-- {SCENE_NAME} — wave_defense recipe.
import "CoreLibs/crank"
import "CoreLibs/timer"

local gfx <const> = playdate.graphics
local Scene = {}
local state = {}
local CX, CY = 200, 120
local COOLDOWN_MS = 250

function Scene.enter()
    state.aim     = 0
    state.bullets = {}
    state.enemies = {}
    state.wave    = 1
    state.hp      = 5
    state.cooldown_ms = 0
    state.spawned = 0
    state.sfx_fire = playdate.sound.sampleplayer.new("sfx/{SCENE_ID}_fire")
    state.sfx_hit  = playdate.sound.sampleplayer.new("sfx/{SCENE_ID}_hit")
end

function Scene.exit() end

local function spawn_enemy()
    local angle = math.random() * math.pi * 2
    local r = 240
    table.insert(state.enemies, { x = CX + math.cos(angle)*r, y = CY + math.sin(angle)*r, hp = 1 })
end

function Scene.update(dt)
    playdate.timer.updateTimers()
    state.aim = playdate.getCrankPosition()
    state.cooldown_ms = math.max(0, state.cooldown_ms - (dt or 1/30) * 1000)
    if playdate.buttonIsPressed(playdate.kButtonA) and state.cooldown_ms == 0 then
        local rad = math.rad(state.aim - 90)
        table.insert(state.bullets, { x = CX, y = CY, vx = math.cos(rad)*6, vy = math.sin(rad)*6 })
        state.cooldown_ms = COOLDOWN_MS
        if state.sfx_fire then state.sfx_fire:play(1) end
    end
    local target = 3 + state.wave * 2
    if state.spawned < target and math.random() < 0.02 + state.wave * 0.005 then
        spawn_enemy()
        state.spawned = state.spawned + 1
    end
    for i = #state.bullets, 1, -1 do
        local b = state.bullets[i]
        b.x = b.x + b.vx; b.y = b.y + b.vy
        if b.x < -10 or b.x > 410 or b.y < -10 or b.y > 250 then table.remove(state.bullets, i) end
    end
    for ei = #state.enemies, 1, -1 do
        local e = state.enemies[ei]
        local dx, dy = CX - e.x, CY - e.y
        local d = math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy)
        if d < 20 then
            state.hp = state.hp - 1
            table.remove(state.enemies, ei)
            if state.hp <= 0 then scene_manager.pop(); return end
        else
            local speed = 0.6 + state.wave * 0.2
            e.x = e.x + dx / d * speed
            e.y = e.y + dy / d * speed
            for bi = #state.bullets, 1, -1 do
                local b = state.bullets[bi]
                local bdx, bdy = e.x - b.x, e.y - b.y
                if bdx*bdx + bdy*bdy < 144 then
                    table.remove(state.enemies, ei)
                    table.remove(state.bullets, bi)
                    if state.sfx_hit then state.sfx_hit:play(1) end
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if state.spawned >= target and #state.enemies == 0 then
        state.wave = state.wave + 1
        state.spawned = 0
        if state.wave > 5 then scene_manager.pop() end
    end
end

function Scene.draw()
    gfx.clear(gfx.kColorWhite)
    gfx.fillCircleAtPoint(CX, CY, 14)
    local rad = math.rad(state.aim - 90)
    gfx.drawLine(CX, CY, CX + math.cos(rad)*28, CY + math.sin(rad)*28)
    for _, b in ipairs(state.bullets) do gfx.fillRect(b.x-2, b.y-2, 4, 4) end
    for _, e in ipairs(state.enemies) do gfx.fillRect(e.x-12, e.y-12, 24, 24) end
    gfx.drawText(string.format("WAVE %d   HP %d", state.wave, state.hp), 8, 8)
    gfx.drawText("[CRANK] aim  [A] fire  [B] abandon", 8, 220)
end

function Scene.input(evt)
    if evt == "b" then scene_manager.pop() end
end
return Scene

recipes.name: Code lock combo
recipes.premise: Rotary combination lock with N wheels. Crank rotates the active wheel; A locks the value and advances; B steps back. All wheels matching the target combo opens the lock. Listen for the audible click-into-place tell on the correct value.
recipes.visual_brief: Center: three side-by-side dials each 80x120 showing current number large (Roobert 24 cap height). Active wheel highlighted with a 2px black border, inactive dimmed by Bayer 8x8 overlay. Above each wheel: tiny tick marks. Bottom: status text plus controls strip.
recipes.lua_template:
-- scenes/{SCENE_ID}.lua
-- {SCENE_NAME} — code_lock_combo recipe.
import "CoreLibs/crank"

local gfx <const> = playdate.graphics
local Scene = {}
local state = {}
local WHEEL_MAX = 40
local CRANK_QUANTUM = 9

function Scene.enter()
    state.wheels = { 0, 0, 0 }
    state.target = { 17, 4, 22 }
    state.active = 1
    state.crank_accum = 0
    state.cleared = false
    state.sfx_tick = playdate.sound.sampleplayer.new("sfx/{SCENE_ID}_tick")
    state.sfx_set  = playdate.sound.sampleplayer.new("sfx/{SCENE_ID}_set")
    state.tell_synth = playdate.sound.synth.new(playdate.sound.kWaveSine)
    state.tell_synth:setADSR(0.0, 0.05, 0.3, 0.1)
end

function Scene.exit() end

local function tick_wheel(self, dir)
    local idx = self.active
    self.wheels[idx] = (self.wheels[idx] + dir) % WHEEL_MAX
    if self.wheels[idx] == self.target[idx] then
        if self.tell_synth then self.tell_synth:playNote("C5", 0.3, 0.1) end
    end
    if self.sfx_tick then self.sfx_tick:play(1) end
end

function Scene.update(_dt)
    if state.cleared then return end
    local change = playdate.getCrankChange()
    state.crank_accum = state.crank_accum + change
    while state.crank_accum >= CRANK_QUANTUM do tick_wheel(state,  1); state.crank_accum = state.crank_accum - CRANK_QUANTUM end
    while state.crank_accum <= -CRANK_QUANTUM do tick_wheel(state, -1); state.crank_accum = state.crank_accum + CRANK_QUANTUM end
    if playdate.buttonJustPressed(playdate.kButtonA) then
        if state.sfx_set then state.sfx_set:play(1) end
        state.active = state.active + 1
        if state.active > #state.wheels then
            local ok = true
            for i, v in ipairs(state.wheels) do if v ~= state.target[i] then ok = false end end
            if ok then state.cleared = true else state.active = 1; for i = 1, #state.wheels do state.wheels[i] = 0 end end
        end
    end
    if playdate.buttonJustPressed(playdate.kButtonB) then
        if state.active > 1 then state.active = state.active - 1 else scene_manager.pop() end
    end
end

function Scene.draw()
    gfx.clear(gfx.kColorWhite)
    for i, v in ipairs(state.wheels) do
        local x = 60 + (i-1) * 110
        if i == state.active then gfx.drawRect(x-4, 60, 88, 124) end
        gfx.drawRect(x, 64, 80, 116)
        gfx.drawText(string.format("%02d", v), x + 16, 100)
    end
    if state.cleared then gfx.drawText("** UNLOCKED **", 140, 210) end
    gfx.drawText("[CRANK] rotate  [A] lock  [B] back", 8, 220)
end

function Scene.input(_) end
return Scene

recipes.name: Memory recall
recipes.premise: Sequence of glyphs flashes onscreen; player reproduces it by crank-selecting + A-committing each glyph from a 12-tile palette. Length grows each round. Three wrong reproductions ends.
recipes.visual_brief: Grid of 12 glyph tiles (4x3) lower screen at 48x48 each. Selected tile inverted. During show phase: each tile in the sequence inverts in turn for 600ms (or longer if reduce-flashing is on). Round number top-left, lives as 3 pips top-right.
recipes.lua_template:
-- scenes/{SCENE_ID}.lua
-- {SCENE_NAME} — memory_recall recipe.
import "CoreLibs/crank"
import "CoreLibs/timer"

local gfx <const> = playdate.graphics
local Scene = {}
local state = {}
local PALETTE_SIZE = 12
local COLS = 4

function Scene.enter()
    state.sequence = {}
    state.input_buffer = {}
    state.cursor = 1
    state.round = 1
    state.lives = 3
    state.phase = "show"
    state.show_index = 1
    state.show_ms = 0
    state.sfx_chirp = playdate.sound.sampleplayer.new("sfx/{SCENE_ID}_chirp")
    state.fail_synth = playdate.sound.synth.new(playdate.sound.kWaveSquare)
    state.fail_synth:setADSR(0.0, 0.1, 0.4, 0.2)
    Scene._start_round()
end

function Scene._start_round()
    state.input_buffer = {}
    state.cursor = 1
    state.phase = "show"
    state.show_index = 1
    state.show_ms = 0
    table.insert(state.sequence, math.random(1, PALETTE_SIZE))
end

function Scene.exit() end

local SHOW_INTERVAL_MS = 600

function Scene.update(dt)
    playdate.timer.updateTimers()
    local dt_ms = (dt or 1/30) * 1000
    if state.phase == "show" then
        state.show_ms = state.show_ms + dt_ms
        local pace = playdate.getReduceFlashing() and SHOW_INTERVAL_MS * 1.6 or SHOW_INTERVAL_MS
        if state.show_ms >= pace then
            state.show_ms = 0
            state.show_index = state.show_index + 1
            if state.show_index > #state.sequence then
                state.phase = "recall"
            end
        end
    elseif state.phase == "recall" then
        local ticks = playdate.getCrankTicks(PALETTE_SIZE)
        if ticks ~= 0 then
            state.cursor = ((state.cursor - 1 + ticks) % PALETTE_SIZE + PALETTE_SIZE) % PALETTE_SIZE + 1
        end
        if playdate.buttonJustPressed(playdate.kButtonA) then
            table.insert(state.input_buffer, state.cursor)
            if state.sfx_chirp then state.sfx_chirp:play(1) end
            local idx = #state.input_buffer
            if state.input_buffer[idx] ~= state.sequence[idx] then
                state.lives = state.lives - 1
                if state.fail_synth then state.fail_synth:playNote("E3", 0.5, 0.3) end
                if state.lives <= 0 then scene_manager.pop(); return end
                state.input_buffer = {}
                state.phase = "show"
                state.show_index = 1
            elseif idx == #state.sequence then
                state.round = state.round + 1
                Scene._start_round()
            end
        end
    end
    if playdate.buttonJustPressed(playdate.kButtonB) then Scene.enter() end
end

function Scene.draw()
    gfx.clear(gfx.kColorWhite)
    gfx.drawText("ROUND " .. tostring(state.round), 8, 8)
    gfx.drawText("LIVES " .. tostring(state.lives), 320, 8)
    local active_show = (state.phase == "show") and state.sequence[state.show_index]
    for i = 1, PALETTE_SIZE do
        local col = (i - 1) % COLS
        local row = math.floor((i - 1) / COLS)
        local x = 56 + col * 72
        local y = 80 + row * 56
        if i == active_show or (state.phase == "recall" and i == state.cursor) then
            gfx.fillRect(x, y, 48, 48)
            gfx.setImageDrawMode(gfx.kDrawModeFillWhite)
            gfx.drawText(tostring(i), x + 16, y + 14)
            gfx.setImageDrawMode(gfx.kDrawModeCopy)
        else
            gfx.drawRect(x, y, 48, 48)
            gfx.drawText(tostring(i), x + 16, y + 14)
        end
    end
    gfx.drawText("[CRANK] cursor  [A] commit  [B] restart", 8, 220)
end

function Scene.input(_) end
return Scene

recipes.name: Top-down explore
recipes.premise: Walk a small overworld with the d-pad. Sprite collides with walls. Hotspots interact on A (door, NPC, item). Camera follows the player. Useful as a hub or village scene.
recipes.visual_brief: Top-down 32x32 tiles. Player sprite 32x32 with 4-direction walk cycle (4 frames each). Hotspots invisible by default; show a small triangle hint above the player when within range. Camera lags 4 frames behind movement (no abrupt cuts).
recipes.lua_template:
-- scenes/{SCENE_ID}.lua
-- {SCENE_NAME} — top_down_explore recipe.
import "CoreLibs/sprites"
import "CoreLibs/animation"

local gfx <const> = playdate.graphics
local Scene = {}
local state = {}

function Scene.enter()
    state.player = { x=120, y=120, facing="south" }
    state.hotspots = {
        { x=240, y=120, r=24, label="DOOR",    on_interact=function() scene_manager.push("{SCENE_ID}_inside") end },
        { x=80,  y=200, r=24, label="COURIER", on_interact=function() scene_manager.push("{SCENE_ID}_talk")   end }
    }
    state.camera_x, state.camera_y = 0, 0
    state.frames = playdate.graphics.imagetable.new("images/{SCENE_ID}_player")
    if state.frames then
        state.anim = playdate.graphics.animation.loop.new(120, state.frames, true)
    end
    state.music = playdate.sound.fileplayer.new("music/{SCENE_ID}_ambient")
    if state.music then state.music:play(0) end
end

function Scene.exit() if state.music then state.music:stop() end end

function Scene.update(_dt)
    local vx, vy = 0, 0
    if playdate.buttonIsPressed(playdate.kButtonRight) then vx = 2; state.player.facing = "east"  end
    if playdate.buttonIsPressed(playdate.kButtonLeft)  then vx = -2; state.player.facing = "west"  end
    if playdate.buttonIsPressed(playdate.kButtonDown)  then vy = 2; state.player.facing = "south" end
    if playdate.buttonIsPressed(playdate.kButtonUp)    then vy = -2; state.player.facing = "north" end
    state.player.x = math.max(8, math.min(792, state.player.x + vx))
    state.player.y = math.max(8, math.min(472, state.player.y + vy))
    state.camera_x = state.camera_x + (state.player.x - 200 - state.camera_x) * 0.2
    state.camera_y = state.camera_y + (state.player.y - 120 - state.camera_y) * 0.2
    if playdate.buttonJustPressed(playdate.kButtonA) then
        for _, h in ipairs(state.hotspots) do
            local dx, dy = state.player.x - h.x, state.player.y - h.y
            if dx*dx + dy*dy < h.r * h.r then h.on_interact(); break end
        end
    end
end

function Scene.draw()
    gfx.clear(gfx.kColorWhite)
    gfx.setDrawOffset(-math.floor(state.camera_x), -math.floor(state.camera_y))
    for _, h in ipairs(state.hotspots) do gfx.drawCircleAtPoint(h.x, h.y, h.r) end
    if state.anim then state.anim:draw(state.player.x - 16, state.player.y - 16)
    else gfx.fillRect(state.player.x - 8, state.player.y - 8, 16, 16) end
    gfx.setDrawOffset(0, 0)
    gfx.drawText("[D-PAD] walk  [A] interact  [B] menu", 8, 220)
end

function Scene.input(evt)
    if evt == "b" then scene_manager.push("pause") end
end
return Scene

recipes.name: Side-scroll platform
recipes.premise: 2D platformer scene. D-pad walks left/right, A jumps, B dashes. Gravity + simple platforming. Coins to collect, a goal flag to reach. Camera scrolls horizontally.
recipes.visual_brief: Parallax 2-layer background (Bayer 8x8 distant, Atkinson midground). Player 24x32 four-frame run cycle, two-frame jump. Coins 12x12 with 4-frame spin. Platforms tile-edged with 1px highlight on top. Camera scrolls horizontal only.
recipes.lua_template:
-- scenes/{SCENE_ID}.lua
-- {SCENE_NAME} — side_scroll_platform recipe.
import "CoreLibs/sprites"
import "CoreLibs/animation"
import "CoreLibs/easing"

local gfx <const> = playdate.graphics
local Scene = {}
local state = {}
local GRAVITY = 0.6
local JUMP_VY = -10
local DASH_VX = 9
local DASH_COOLDOWN = 700

function Scene.enter()
    state.player = { x=40, y=180, vx=0, vy=0, on_ground=false, dash_cd_ms=0, jump_held_ms=0 }
    state.platforms = {
        { x=0,   y=216, w=400, h=24 },
        { x=180, y=170, w=80,  h=12 },
        { x=320, y=130, w=80,  h=12 },
        { x=480, y=160, w=80,  h=12 },
        { x=620, y=200, w=120, h=24 }
    }
    state.coins = {
        { x=200, y=140, taken=false }, { x=340, y=100, taken=false }, { x=500, y=130, taken=false }
    }
    state.goal_x = 740
    state.camera_x = 0
    state.sfx_jump = playdate.sound.sampleplayer.new("sfx/{SCENE_ID}_jump")
    state.sfx_coin = playdate.sound.sampleplayer.new("sfx/{SCENE_ID}_coin")
end

function Scene.exit() end

local function on_platform(p)
    local x, y = state.player.x, state.player.y
    return x + 8 > p.x and x - 8 < p.x + p.w and y >= p.y - 1 and y <= p.y + 4
end

function Scene.update(dt)
    local dt_ms = (dt or 1/30) * 1000
    local ax = 0
    if playdate.buttonIsPressed(playdate.kButtonRight) then ax = 0.6 end
    if playdate.buttonIsPressed(playdate.kButtonLeft)  then ax = -0.6 end
    state.player.vx = state.player.vx + ax
    state.player.vx = state.player.vx * 0.86
    state.player.vy = state.player.vy + GRAVITY
    if playdate.buttonJustPressed(playdate.kButtonA) and state.player.on_ground then
        state.player.vy = JUMP_VY
        state.player.on_ground = false
        state.player.jump_held_ms = 0
        if state.sfx_jump then state.sfx_jump:play(1) end
    end
    if playdate.buttonIsPressed(playdate.kButtonA) and state.player.jump_held_ms < 180 and state.player.vy < 0 then
        state.player.vy = state.player.vy - 0.4
        state.player.jump_held_ms = state.player.jump_held_ms + dt_ms
    end
    state.player.dash_cd_ms = math.max(0, state.player.dash_cd_ms - dt_ms)
    if playdate.buttonJustPressed(playdate.kButtonB) and state.player.dash_cd_ms == 0 then
        state.player.vx = state.player.vx + (state.player.vx >= 0 and DASH_VX or -DASH_VX)
        state.player.dash_cd_ms = DASH_COOLDOWN
    end
    state.player.x = state.player.x + state.player.vx
    state.player.y = state.player.y + state.player.vy
    state.player.on_ground = false
    for _, p in ipairs(state.platforms) do
        if state.player.vy >= 0 and on_platform(p) then
            state.player.y = p.y
            state.player.vy = 0
            state.player.on_ground = true
        end
    end
    for _, c in ipairs(state.coins) do
        if (not c.taken) and math.abs(c.x - state.player.x) < 14 and math.abs(c.y - state.player.y) < 18 then
            c.taken = true
            if state.sfx_coin then state.sfx_coin:play(1) end
        end
    end
    if state.player.x >= state.goal_x then scene_manager.pop() end
    state.camera_x = math.max(0, math.min(state.player.x - 200, 400))
end

function Scene.draw()
    gfx.clear(gfx.kColorWhite)
    gfx.setDrawOffset(-math.floor(state.camera_x), 0)
    for _, p in ipairs(state.platforms) do gfx.fillRect(p.x, p.y, p.w, p.h) end
    for _, c in ipairs(state.coins) do
        if not c.taken then gfx.drawCircleAtPoint(c.x, c.y, 6) end
    end
    gfx.fillRect(state.goal_x, 120, 4, 100)
    gfx.fillRect(state.player.x - 8, state.player.y - 24, 16, 24)
    gfx.setDrawOffset(0, 0)
    gfx.drawText("[D-PAD] move  [A] jump  [B] dash", 8, 220)
end

function Scene.input(_) end
return Scene
